newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudis to start investment holding firm in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Saudis to start investment holding firm in Bahrain.

text.p: The Bahrain Monetary Agency has issued licenses to Saudi investors to set up a investment holding firm in Bahrain, a local newspaper said on Monday.

The al-Ayam Arabic newspaper said the firm, which would be known as the Holding Company for Investment Capital, would operate as an investment bank and have a capital of $150 million distributed among shareholders. It did not give more details.
The newspaper quoted an agency statement as saying the new bank would increase to 30 the number of investment banks operating in Bahrain with a combined budget of more than $4 billion.
